title: Customer and Vendor Statements
summary: Statement of account PDF per partner: opening balance, running balance, ageing buckets, sent from the contact
intro: A statement of account is what a customer asks for when they want to agree what they owe you, and what you send at month end to prompt payment. Odoo 19 Community shows a partner ledger on screen but has no printable, mailable statement. This module adds one: pick contacts and a period, print one PDF per partner with opening balance, every movement with a running balance, closing balance and ageing buckets, or send it straight from the contact with the PDF attached to the chatter.
features: Wizard from Contacts, one or many
Select the contacts, choose the date range, pick Activity or Outstanding only, and tick Include Vendor Side when a partner is both customer and supplier. Print, or send by email.
Opening balance, then one line per posted document with date, document number, reference, due date, debit, credit and the running balance, then the closing balance and the ageing table.
Ageing as at the statement date

0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days, counted from the due date. Open amounts are replayed from the reconciliations dated on or before the end date, so a statement reprinted for last quarter shows what was open then.
A foreign-currency invoice is listed at the company-currency value of its journal item, with the original amount noted beside the reference, so the running balance stays one ledger figure.
Send with the PDF on the chatter
Send by Email renders the PDF, posts it on the contact's chatter as a message with the PDF attached, and emails it with a mail template you can edit under Email Templates.
A Statement smart button on every contact, four ageing fields with the total due on the Invoicing tab, and a company bank account and footer note chosen under Invoicing settings.
notes: Works on Odoo 19 Community. The only dependency is Invoicing (account).
Reads posted receivable and payable journal items only; drafts never appear.
A contact person's invoices roll up to the statement of their company.
Items not yet due are shown in the 0-30 bucket, so the four buckets always add up to the total due.
The ageing fields on the contact are computed when read and never stored, so they are always current.
No follow-up levels, reminders or scheduled jobs; it prints and sends what you ask for.
paid_sentence: The drkds Accounting Pro app adds payment follow-up levels, automated reminders and collection dashboards.
